name: Vocoder Rain
description: Live digital voice as digital rain: each 20 ms vocoder frame falls as a streak of its own bits, tagged with its talkgroup and talker, over a faint layer of the control channel's messages. A novelty.

screenshots.caption: Each streak is a talker's vocoder frames in hex, bright at the head and dimming behind; damaged frames fall in red, tags name the talkgroup and the radio, and the control channel is a faint layer behind
Mirrored kana, digits and symbols, coloured by talkgroup, with the control channel a little brighter
